The definition's justified_by label-space lemma depends on the definition. Rank is already defined as the dimension of the span of all labels; treat isotropy and subgroup order as later results and remove this justification cycle.
The statement includes n=0, while its symplectic-form supplier's proof only establishes nondegeneracy for n>=1. Add the zero-space case explicitly without narrowing the statement.

The statement covers n=0, but the cited quotient-isomorphism and Hermitian-phase results apply to n>=1. Prove the zero-qubit case from the scalar Pauli convention: excluding -I leaves S={I}, with singleton label image and order 1.
The unrestricted-n statement uses quotient and phase results scoped to n>=1. Add a zero-qubit case using the scalar Pauli convention and make that supplier explicit in deps.
The statement also covers n=0, but its quotient and Hermitian-phase suppliers are scoped to n>=1. Prove the empty-row case directly: the row product is I and the Hermitian measured Pauli is ±I.

The input bits use indices 0..n-1, while the phase-aware Pauli supplier labels wires 1..n. The claimed Z_0 row is undefined under that supplier convention. State the rows as s_{j+1}=(-1)^{x_j}Z_{j+1} and d_{j+1}=X_{j+1}.

Circuit wires are 0-based but tableau Clifford updates take 1-based wires; no translation is specified. Add the mapping j↦j+1, define S† as S*, and give the explicit root-to-leaf loop and successor transition for gate and measurement nodes.
T may be zero, yet the time bound then omits the O((n+1)^2) work to initialize and output dense signed rows. Include an initialization/output term, for example O((n+1)^2 + T(n+1)^3 + C_cl).
